newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: N.Korean navy ship returns after intruding South.
newsitem.headline: N.Korean navy ship returns after intruding South.

text.p: A North Korean navy vessel intruded into South Korean waters on Thursday, apparently by mistake, the Seoul defence ministry said.
"The ship was first spotted at 2.05 p.m. (0505 GMT) and returned by 3.00 p.m.," the official said. "It seems that the ship mistakenly entered our waters."
The North Korean vessel was spotted just south of the military demarcation line, which has separated the two Koreas since a truce ended the 1950-53 Korean War.
Four South Korean navy vessels were immediately dispatched to the area, the official said. There was no contact at all with the North Korean boat.
The official said it was the first such intrusion since May 1996.
The North Korean vessel appeared to be following a Chinese cargo vessel, he said.
